soundproof.textEn: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.
soundproof.textEs: Su aislamiento acústico lo protege de movimientos que usan sonido.
soundproof.detail: This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. Heal Bell is unaffected. Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used. Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based.

static.textEn: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.
static.textEs: La electricidad estática que lo envuelve puede paralizar al mínimo contacto.
static.detail: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed. Pokémon that are immune to Electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an Electric Pokémon, if applicable.

aftermath.textEn: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.
aftermath.textEs: Daña al agresor que le ha dado el golpe de gracia con un movimiento de contacto.
aftermath.detail: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.

keen-eye.textEn: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.
keen-eye.textEs: Su aguda vista evita que le disminuya la Precisión.
keen-eye.detail: This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered. This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate. This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through Heart Swap. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

tangled-feet.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.
tangled-feet.textEs: Sube su Evasión si está confuso.
tangled-feet.detail: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.

big-pecks.textEn: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.
big-pecks.textEs: Impide que el rival le baje la Defensa.
big-pecks.detail: This Pokémon's Defense cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Defense modifiers through Heart Swap or Guard Swap.

vital-spirit.textEn: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
vital-spirit.textEs: Su determinación le impide quedarse dormido.
vital-spirit.detail: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Insomnia in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

pickup.textEn: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
pickup.textEs: Puede recoger objetos que el rival haya usado, o bien otros que encuentre en plena aventura.
pickup.detail: At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one. After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one. The Air Balloon and Eject Button cannot be picked up. The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

run-away.textEn: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.
run-away.textEs: Puede escaparse de todos los Pokémon salvajes.
run-away.detail: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.

gluttony.textEn: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.
gluttony.textEs: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, engulle la baya que normalmente solo se comería cuando le quedasen pocos PS.
gluttony.detail: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.

quick-feet.textEn: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.
quick-feet.textEs: Aumenta la Velocidad si sufre problemas de estado.
quick-feet.detail: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

frisk.textEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.
frisk.textEs: Puede ver el objeto que lleva el rival al entrar en combate.
frisk.detail: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers. In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.

rattled.textEn: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.
rattled.textEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, Bicho o Fantasma, el miedo hace que le suba la Velocidad.
rattled.detail: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage with each hit from a damaging Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type move.

truant.textEn: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.
truant.textEs: Al ejecutar un movimiento, descansará en el turno siguiente.
truant.detail: Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around"). Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do. Most such moves, for example Bide or Rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around. Attacks with a recharge turn, such as Hyper Beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as Fly, do not end up being used. Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as Outrage, Uproar, or any move forced by Encore, keep going as usual. If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending. If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or Gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn. If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did. This ability cannot be changed with Worry Seed, but it can be disabled with Gastro Acid, changed with Role Play, or traded away with Skill Swap.

synchronize.textEn: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.
synchronize.textEs: Contagia el envenenamiento, las quemaduras o la parálisis al Pokémon que le cause ese estado.
synchronize.detail: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.

trace.textEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.
trace.textEs: Al entrar en combate copia la habilidad del rival.
trace.detail: When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.

telepathy.textEn: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.
telepathy.textEs: Elude los ataques de los aliados durante el combate.
telepathy.detail: This Pokémon does not take damage from friendly Pokémon's moves, including single-target moves aimed at it.

swift-swim.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.
swift-swim.detail: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

water-veil.textEn: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.
water-veil.textEs: Evita las quemaduras gracias a la capa de agua que lo envuelve.
water-veil.detail: This Pokémon cannot be burned. If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

lightning-rod.textEn: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
lightning-rod.textEs: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
lightning-rod.detail: All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability. If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.

thick-fat.textEn: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
thick-fat.textEs: Gracias a la gruesa capa de grasa que lo protege, reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques de tipo Fuego o Hielo.
thick-fat.detail: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

huge-power.textEs: Duplica la potencia de sus ataques físicos.
huge-power.detail: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Pure Power.

sap-sipper.textEn: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.
sap-sipper.textEs: Neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Planta y sube su Ataque.
sap-sipper.detail: Whenever a Grass-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage, negating any other effect on it.

hydration.textEn: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.
hydration.textEs: Cura los problemas de estado si está lloviendo.
hydration.detail: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

rain-dish.textEn: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.
rain-dish.textEs: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando llueve.
rain-dish.detail: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.

chlorophyll.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.
chlorophyll.textEs: Sube su Velocidad cuando hace sol.
chlorophyll.detail: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

serene-grace.textEn: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.
serene-grace.textEs: Aumenta la probabilidad de que los movimientos causen efectos secundarios.
serene-grace.detail: This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but Protect's chance of success and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected. Secret Power is unaffected.

clear-body.textEn: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.
clear-body.textEs: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
clear-body.detail: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.

liquid-ooze.textEn: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.
liquid-ooze.textEs: Exuda una sustancia tóxica de intenso hedor que hiere a quienes intentan drenarle PS.
liquid-ooze.detail: Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like Absorb, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain. Dream Eater is unaffected.

poison-point.textEn: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
poison-point.detail: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

intimidate.textEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.
intimidate.textEs: Al entrar en combate amilana al rival de tal manera que su Ataque disminuye.
intimidate.detail: When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage. In a double battle, both opponents are affected. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle. This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

poison-touch.textEn: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.
poison-touch.textEs: Puede envenenar al objetivo con solo tocarlo.
poison-touch.detail: This Pokémon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning the target with each hit. This counts as an extra effect for the purposes of Shield Dust. This ability takes effect before Mummy.

adaptability.textEn: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.
adaptability.textEs: Potencia aún más los movimientos cuyo tipo coincida con el suyo.
adaptability.detail: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.

shield-dust.textEn: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.
shield-dust.textEs: El polvo de escamas que lo envuelve lo protege de los efectos secundarios de los ataques recibidos.
shield-dust.detail: This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it. An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.

shed-skin.textEn: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.
shed-skin.textEs: Puede curar sus problemas de estado al mudar la piel.
shed-skin.detail: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.

insomnia.textEn: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.
insomnia.textEs: Su resistencia al sueño le impide quedarse dormido.
insomnia.detail: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Vital Spirit in battle.

stakeout.textEn: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.
stakeout.textEs: Si el objetivo de su ataque es sustituido por otro, duplica el daño que infligirá.
stakeout.detail: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.

effect-spore.textEn: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.
effect-spore.textEs: Puede dormir, envenenar o paralizar al Pokémon con el que entre en contacto al recibir un ataque.
effect-spore.detail: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random. Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.

poison-heal.textEn: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
poison-heal.textEs: Si resulta envenenado, recupera PS en vez de perderlos.
poison-heal.detail: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage. This includes bad poison.

wimp-out.textEn: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
wimp-out.textEs: Se asusta y abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad.
wimp-out.detail: After this Pokémon is hit by a move, if that move caused this Pokémon's HP to drop below half, it switches out.

honey-gather.textEn: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.
honey-gather.textEs: Puede que encuentre Miel una vez concluido el combate.
honey-gather.detail: This Pokémon has a chance of picking up Honey after each battle. This chance starts at 5% and rises another 5% after every tenth level: 5% from level 1–10, 10% from 11–20, and so on, up to 50% from 91–100. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

hustle.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.
hustle.textEs: Aumenta su Ataque, pero reduce su Precisión.
hustle.detail: This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy. Special moves are unaffected. Moves that do set damage, such as Seismic Toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

own-tempo.textEn: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.
own-tempo.textEs: Como le gusta hacer las cosas a su manera, los rivales no logran confundirlo.
own-tempo.detail: This Pokémon cannot be confused. If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.

early-bird.textEn: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.
early-bird.textEs: Si se duerme, tardará la mitad de tiempo en despertarse.
early-bird.detail: This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1. If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.

pickpocket.textEn: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.
pickpocket.textEs: Si el rival usa un movimiento de contacto al atacar, le roba el objeto.
pickpocket.detail: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, if it does not have a held item, it steals the attacker's held item. This Pokémon cannot steal upon being knocked out. It can steal if the attacker has a Substitute, but cannot steal when its own Substitute is hit. If a move hits multiple times, only the last hit triggers this ability. If this Pokémon is wild, it cannot steal from a trained Pokémon.

guts.textEn: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.
guts.textEs: Si sufre un problema de estado, se viene arriba y aumenta su Ataque.
guts.detail: Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

scrappy.textEn: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.
scrappy.textEs: Puede alcanzar a Pokémon de tipo Fantasma con movimientos de tipo Normal o Lucha.
scrappy.detail: This Pokémon ignores Ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.

damp.textEn: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.
damp.textEs: Aumenta la humedad del entorno y evita que se puedan utilizar movimientos explosivos, tales como Autodestrucción.
damp.detail: While this Pokémon is in battle, Self-Destruct and Explosion will fail and Aftermath will not take effect.

cloud-nine.textEs: Anula todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico.
cloud-nine.detail: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.

oblivious.textEn: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.
oblivious.textEs: Su indiferencia evita que sea provocado o caiga presa del enamoramiento.
oblivious.detail: This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate. If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.

cute-charm.textEn: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.
cute-charm.textEs: Puede causar enamoramiento al rival que lo toque.
cute-charm.detail: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.

competitive.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.
competitive.textEs: Aumenta mucho su Ataque Especial cuando el rival le baja cualquiera de sus características.
competitive.detail: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

friend-guard.textEs: Reduce el daño que sufren los aliados.
friend-guard.detail: All friendly Pokémon take 0.75× as much direct damage from moves while this Pokémon is in battle. This effect stacks if multiple allied Pokémon have it.

illuminate.textEn: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.
illuminate.textEs: Aumenta la probabilidad de encontrar Pokémon al iluminar el entorno.
illuminate.detail: Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled. This ability has no effect in battle.

natural-cure.textEn: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.
natural-cure.textEs: Cura sus problemas de estado al cambiarse con otro Pokémon.
natural-cure.detail: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon. If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.

analytic.textEn: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.
analytic.textEs: Aumenta la potencia de su movimiento si es el último en atacar.
analytic.detail: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their power when it moves last in a turn. Future Sight and Doom Desire are unaffected.

sniper.textEn: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.
sniper.textEs: Potencia los golpes críticos que asesta aún más de lo normal.
sniper.detail: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.

drizzle.textEn: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.
drizzle.textEs: Hace que llueva al entrar en combate.
drizzle.detail: The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

hyper-cutter.textEn: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.
hyper-cutter.textEs: Evita que el rival le baje el Ataque.
hyper-cutter.detail: This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through Heart Swap or Power Swap.

shell-armor.textEn: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
shell-armor.textEs: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
shell-armor.detail: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Battle Armor.

sheer-force.textEn: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.
sheer-force.textEs: Sube la potencia de sus movimientos en detrimento de los efectos secundarios, que se ven anulados.
sheer-force.detail: This Pokémon's moves with extra effects have 1.3× their power, but lose their extra effects. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate. Moves that lower the user's stats are unaffected.

water-absorb.textEn: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
water-absorb.textEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
water-absorb.detail: Whenever a Water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.

cursed-body.textEn: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.
cursed-body.textEs: Puede anular el movimiento usado en su contra.
cursed-body.detail: Moves that hit this Pokémon have a 30% chance of being Disabled afterward.

moody.textEn: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.
moody.textEs: Una característica le sube mucho en cada turno, pero le baja otra.
moody.detail: After each turn, one of this Pokémon's stats at random rises two stages, and another falls one stage. If a stat is already at 6 or -6 stages, it will not be chosen to be increased or decreased, respectively.

levitate.textEn: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
levitate.textEs: Su capacidad de flotar sobre el suelo le proporciona inmunidad frente a los movimientos de tipo Tierra.
levitate.detail: This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost.

motor-drive.textEn: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.
motor-drive.textEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, le sube la Velocidad en vez de sufrir daño.
motor-drive.detail: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.

sticky-hold.textEn: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
sticky-hold.textEs: Los objetos se quedan pegados a su cuerpo, por lo que no pueden robárselos.
sticky-hold.detail: This Pokémon's hold item cannot be removed by other Pokémon. Damaging moves that would remove this Pokémon's item can still inflict damage against this Pokémon, e.g. Knock Off or Pluck. This Pokémon can still use moves that involve the loss of its own item, e.g. Fling or Trick. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the encounter rate while fishing is increased.

stench.textEn: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.
stench.textEs: Puede amedrentar al rival al atacarlo debido al mal olor que emana.
stench.detail: This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect. This ability does not stack with a held item. Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.

anticipation.textEn: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.
anticipation.textEs: Prevé los movimientos peligrosos del rival.
anticipation.detail: When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified. The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move. Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as Future Sight, and moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, count as their listed types. Counter, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.

volt-absorb.textEn: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
volt-absorb.textEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
volt-absorb.detail: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.

technician.textEn: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.
technician.detail: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less. This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.

skill-link.textEn: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.
skill-link.textEs: Ejecuta siempre los movimientos múltiples con el número máximo de golpes.
skill-link.detail: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear. It also bypasses the accuracy checks on Triple Kick's second and third hits.

commander.textEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
commander.textEs: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
commander.detail: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

storm-drain.textEn: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
storm-drain.textEs: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Agua, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
storm-drain.detail: All other Pokémon's single-target Water-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon, if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Water moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability.

inner-focus.textEn: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.
inner-focus.textEs: Gracias a su profunda concentración, no se amedrenta ante los ataques del rival.

infiltrator.textEn: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.
infiltrator.textEs: Ataca sorteando la barrera o el sustituto del rival.
infiltrator.detail: This Pokémon's moves ignore Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

thermal-exchange.textEn: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
thermal-exchange.textEs: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
thermal-exchange.detail: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

ice-body.textEn: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.
ice-body.textEs: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando hay tormentas de granizo.
ice-body.detail: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during hail, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.

immunity.textEn: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.
immunity.textEs: Su sistema inmunitario evita el envenenamiento.
immunity.detail: This Pokémon cannot be poisoned. This includes bad poison. If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

toxic-boost.textEn: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.
toxic-boost.textEs: Aumenta la potencia de sus ataques físicos cuando está envenenado.
toxic-boost.detail: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Attack when poisoned.

mycelium-might.textEn: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
mycelium-might.textEs: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
mycelium-might.detail: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

contrary.textEn: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.
contrary.textEs: Invierte los cambios en las características: bajan cuando les toca subir y suben cuando les toca bajar.
contrary.detail: Whenever this Pokémon's stats would be raised, they are instead lowered by the same amount, and vice versa.

magma-armor.textEn: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.
magma-armor.textEs: Gracias al magma candente que lo envuelve, no puede ser congelado.
magma-armor.detail: This Pokémon cannot be frozen. If a Pokémon is frozen and acquires this ability, it will immediately thaw out; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Flame Body.

flame-body.textEn: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
flame-body.detail: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor.

weak-armor.textEn: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.
weak-armor.textEs: Al recibir daño de un ataque físico, le baja la Defensa, pero le sube mucho la Velocidad.
weak-armor.detail: Whenever a physical move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage and its Defense falls one stage. This ability triggers on every hit of a multiple-hit move.

neutralizing-gas.textEn: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
neutralizing-gas.textEs: Anula los efectos de las habilidades de los demás Pokémon presentes mientras esté en el terreno de combate.
neutralizing-gas.detail: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

reckless.textEn: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
reckless.textEs: Potencia los movimientos que también dañan al usuario.
reckless.detail: This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power. Struggle is unaffected. The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: Jump Kick and High Jump Kick.

sand-veil.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.
sand-veil.textEs: Aumenta su Evasión durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-veil.detail: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

sand-rush.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.
sand-rush.textEs: Aumenta su Velocidad durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-rush.detail: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during a sandstorm, and it does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.

sturdy.textEn: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.
sturdy.textEs: Evita que el rival pueda debilitarlo de un solo golpe cuando tiene los PS al máximo. También evita los movimientos fulminantes.
sturdy.detail: When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP. Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold. If this Pokémon is holding a Focus Sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.

rock-head.textEn: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
rock-head.textEs: No puede dañarse con sus propios movimientos.
rock-head.detail: This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves. Struggle's recoil is unaffected. This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick.

heavy-metal.detail: This Pokémon has double the usual weight for its species.

sand-spit.textEn: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
sand-spit.textEs: Provoca una tormenta de arena al recibir un ataque.
sand-spit.detail: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.

sand-stream.textEn: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.
sand-stream.textEs: Crea una tormenta de arena al entrar en combate.
sand-stream.detail: The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

sand-force.textEn: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
sand-force.textEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Tierra, Acero y Roca durante las tormentas de arena.
sand-force.detail: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves have 1.3× their base power. This Pokémon does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.

simple.textEn: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.
simple.textEs: Duplica los cambios en las características.
simple.detail: Each stage of this Pokémon's stat modifiers acts as two stages. These doubled stages are still limited to a minimum of -6 and a maximum of 6. This Pokémon can still accumulate less than -3 or more than 3 stages of stat modifiers, even though the extra ones have no effect after doubling.

no-guard.textEn: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.
no-guard.textEs: Al quedar ambos expuestos, tanto sus movimientos como los del rival acertarán siempre.
no-guard.detail: Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss. One-hit KO moves are unaffected. Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like Dig or Fly. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

steadfast.textEn: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.
steadfast.textEs: Cada vez que se amedrenta sube su Velocidad, debido a su voluntad inquebrantable.
steadfast.detail: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.

mold-breaker.textEn: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
mold-breaker.textEs: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
mold-breaker.detail: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.

white-smoke.textEn: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
white-smoke.textEs: El humo blanco que lo protege evita que otros Pokémon le bajen las características.
white-smoke.detail: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis; nor self-inflicted stat drops, such as the Special Attack drop from Overheat; nor opponent-triggered stat boosts, such as the Attack boost from Swagger. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to Clear Body in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.

drought.textEn: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.
drought.textEs: Cuando entra en combate, el tiempo pasa a ser soleado.
drought.detail: The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

corrosion.textEn: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.
corrosion.textEs: Puede envenenar incluso a rivales de tipo Acero o Veneno.
corrosion.detail: This Pokémon's moves and item ignore the usual immunity of Poison and Steel Pokémon when attempting to inflict poison.

anger-point.textEn: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.
anger-point.textEs: Si recibe un golpe crítico, monta en cólera y sube su Ataque hasta el máximo.
anger-point.detail: Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages. This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a Substitute.

defiant.textEn: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.
defiant.textEs: Sube mucho su Ataque cuando el rival le baja las características.
defiant.detail: When any of this Pokémon's stats are lowered, its Attack rises by two stages. If multiple stats are lowered at once, this ability takes effect with each stat lowered.

dancer.textEn: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.
dancer.textEs: Puede copiar inmediatamente cualquier movimiento de baile que haya usado otro Pokémon presente en el combate.
dancer.detail: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.

suction-cups.textEn: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.
suction-cups.textEs: Sus ventosas se aferran al suelo, con lo cual anula movimientos y objetos que fuerzan el relevo.
suction-cups.detail: This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as Whirlwind. Dragon Tail and Circle Throw still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased.

solar-power.textEn: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.
solar-power.textEs: Si hace sol, aumenta su Ataque Especial, pero pierde PS en cada turno.
solar-power.detail: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.

harvest.textEn: May create another Berry after one is used.
harvest.textEs: Puede reutilizar varias veces una misma baya.
harvest.detail: After each turn, if the last item this Pokémon consumed was a Berry and it is not currently holding an item, it has a 50% chance of regaining that Berry, or a 100% chance during strong sunlight.

sweet-veil.textEn: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.
sweet-veil.textEs: No cae dormido y evita también que sus aliados se duerman.

rough-skin.textEn: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.
rough-skin.textEs: Hiere con su piel áspera al rival que lo ataque con un movimiento de contacto.
rough-skin.detail: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Iron Barbs.

speed-boost.textEn: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.
speed-boost.textEs: Aumenta su Velocidad en cada turno.
speed-boost.detail: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.

unburden.textEn: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.
unburden.textEs: Sube su Velocidad si usa o pierde el objeto que lleva.
unburden.detail: When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled. If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost. This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of Knock Off. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. There is no notification when this ability takes effect.

forewarn.textEn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.
forewarn.textEs: Indica el movimiento más potente del rival al entrar en combate.
forewarn.detail: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers. In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random. Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows: Power | Moves ----: | ----- 160 | One-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold 120 | Counter moves: Counter, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat 80 | Variable power or set damage: Crush Grip, Dragon Rage, Electro Ball, Endeavor, Final Gambit, Flail, Frustration, Grass Knot, Gyro Ball, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Hidden Power, Low Kick, Natural Gift, Night Shade, Psywave, Return, Reversal, Seismic Toss, Sonic Boom, Trump Card, and Wring Out 0 | Any such move not listed

prankster.textEn: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.
prankster.textEs: Sus movimientos de estado tienen prioridad alta.
prankster.detail: This Pokémon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by one stage.

magician.textEn: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.
magician.textEs: Roba el objeto del Pokémon al que alcance con un movimiento.
magician.detail: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.

overgrow.textEn: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
overgrow.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
overgrow.detail: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

torrent.textEn: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
torrent.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
torrent.detail: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

pressure.textEn: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.
pressure.textEs: Presiona al rival para que sus PP se acaben antes.
pressure.detail: Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP. This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

healer.textEn: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.
healer.textEs: A veces cura los problemas de estado de un aliado.
healer.detail: Friendly Pokémon next to this Pokémon in double and triple battles each have a 30% chance of being cured of any major status ailment after each turn.

regenerator.textEn: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.
regenerator.textEs: Recupera unos pocos PS al ser cambiado por otro Pokémon.
regenerator.detail: This Pokémon regains 1/3 of its maximum HP when it is switched out for another Pokémon under any circumstances other than having fainted. This ability does not take effect when a battle ends.

gulp-missile.textEn: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
gulp-missile.textEs: Tras usar Surf o Buceo, emerge con una presa en la boca. Al recibir daño, ataca escupiéndola al rival.
gulp-missile.detail: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

moxie.textEn: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.
moxie.textEs: Al debilitar a un objetivo, su confianza se refuerza de tal manera que aumenta su Ataque.
moxie.detail: This Pokémon's Attack rises one stage upon knocking out another Pokémon, even a friendly Pokémon. This ability does not take effect when the Pokémon indirectly causes another Pokémon to faint, e.g. through poison or Spikes. If this Pokémon knocks out a Pokémon with Mummy, the former's ability will change without taking effect.

color-change.textEn: The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.
color-change.textEs: Adopta el tipo del último movimiento del que es blanco.
color-change.detail: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move. If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden. The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a Substitute will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as Spikes. This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack. In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.

protean.textEn: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
protean.textEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
protean.detail: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses. The type change takes place just before the move is used.

wind-power.textEn: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
wind-power.textEs: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
wind-power.detail: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

shadow-tag.textEn: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.
shadow-tag.textEs: Impide que el enemigo huya o sea cambiado por otro.
shadow-tag.detail: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.

flash-fire.textEn: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.
flash-fire.textEs: Si le alcanza algún movimiento de tipo Fuego, potencia sus propios movimientos de dicho tipo.
flash-fire.detail: This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves. Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle. This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen. The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled. Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.

unnerve.textEn: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
unnerve.textEs: Pone nervioso al rival y le impide usar bayas.
unnerve.detail: Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry.

gale-wings.textEn: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.
gale-wings.textEs: Da prioridad a los movimientos de tipo Volador si sus PS están al máximo.
gale-wings.detail: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.

blaze.textEn: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
blaze.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Fuego cuando le quedan pocos PS.
blaze.detail: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

leaf-guard.textEn: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.
leaf-guard.textEs: Evita los problemas de estado si hace sol.
leaf-guard.detail: This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight. This ability does not heal prior status ailments. Rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect. Yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.

swarm.textEn: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
swarm.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Bicho cuando le quedan pocos PS.
swarm.detail: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.

propeller-tail.textEn: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
propeller-tail.textEs: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
propeller-tail.detail: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

battle-armor.textEn: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
battle-armor.textEs: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
battle-armor.detail: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Shell Armor.

magic-guard.textEn: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.
magic-guard.detail: This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move. For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or Spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a Life Orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it. Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, Leech Seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon. The following are unaffected: Struggle, Pain Split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), Belly Drum, Substitute, Curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion. This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with Liquid Ooze. If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.

stall.textEn: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.
stall.textEs: Ejecuta su movimiento tras todos los demás.
stall.detail: This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket. Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves. The Full Incense and Lagging Tail take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability. Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item. This ability works as usual during Trick Room: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.

gooey.textEn: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
gooey.textEs: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
gooey.detail: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.

magnet-pull.textEn: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.
magnet-pull.textEs: Su magnetismo atrae a los Pokémon de tipo Acero y les impide huir.
magnet-pull.detail: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.

iron-fist.textEs: Aumenta la potencia de los puñetazos.
iron-fist.detail: Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon. Sucker Punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".

fluffy.textEn: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
fluffy.textEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño provocado por los movimientos de contacto, pero duplica el infligido por los de tipo Fuego.
fluffy.detail: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

unaware.textEn: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.
unaware.textEs: Pasa por alto las mejoras en las características del rival al atacar.
unaware.detail: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation. Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed. The power of Punishment and Stored Power is calculated as usual. When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.

light-metal.textEs: Reduce a la mitad su peso.
light-metal.detail: This Pokémon has half the usual weight for its species.

arena-trap.textEn: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing from battle.
arena-trap.detail: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to Levitate or Magnet Rise, are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

limber.textEn: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.
limber.textEs: Evita ser paralizado gracias a la flexibilidad de su cuerpo.
limber.detail: This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed. If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

dry-skin.textEn: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.
dry-skin.textEs: Pierde PS si hace sol y los recupera si llueve o recibe un movimiento de tipo Agua. Los movimientos de tipo Fuego, por su parte, le hacen más daño de lo normal.
dry-skin.detail: This Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn during strong sunlight, but it heals for 1/8 of its HP each turn during rain. This Pokémon takes 1.25× as much damage from Fire-type moves, but whenever a Water move hits it, it heals for 1/4 its maximum HP instead.

snow-cloak.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.
snow-cloak.detail: During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.

mega-launcher.textEs: Aumenta la potencia de algunos movimientos de pulsos y auras.
mega-launcher.detail: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.

steelworker.textEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero.
steelworker.detail: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.

strong-jaw.textEn: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
strong-jaw.textEs: Su robusta mandíbula le confiere una mordedura potente.
strong-jaw.detail: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.

dazzling.textEn: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
dazzling.textEs: Desconcierta al rival y le impide utilizar movimientos con prioridad en su contra.
dazzling.detail: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.

wonder-skin.textEn: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.
wonder-skin.textEs: Presenta una mayor resistencia ante los movimientos de estado.
wonder-skin.detail: Non-damaging moves have exactly 50% base accuracy against this Pokémon.

overcoat.textEn: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.
overcoat.textEs: No le afectan las tormentas de arena, el granizo y los movimientos con polvos.
overcoat.detail: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather.

water-compaction.textEn: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.
water-compaction.textEs: Aumenta mucho su Defensa si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua.
water-compaction.detail: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.

magic-bounce.textEn: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.
magic-bounce.textEs: Puede devolver los movimientos de estado lanzados por el rival, sin verse afectado por ellos.
magic-bounce.detail: When this Pokémon is targeted by a move flagged as being reflectable, the move is redirected to its user. All reflectable moves are non-damaging, and most non-damaging moves that target other Pokémon are reflectable. A move reflected by this ability or Magic Coat cannot be reflected back.

compound-eyes.textEn: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.
compound-eyes.textEs: Aumenta la precisión de sus movimientos.
compound-eyes.detail: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy. This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold). Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.

stamina.textEn: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
stamina.textEs: Aumenta su Defensa al recibir un ataque.
stamina.detail: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.

shields-down.textEn: When its HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.
shields-down.textEs: Rompe su coraza cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad y adopta una forma ofensiva.
shields-down.detail: When this Pokémon enters battle and at the end of each turn, if its HP is 50% or above, it changes into Meteor Form; otherwise, it changes into Core Form. In Meteor Form, it cannot be given a major status ailment (though existing ones are not cured), cannot become drowsy from Yawn, and cannot use Rest (which will simply fail). This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified. This ability only takes effect for Minior.

iron-barbs.textEn: Inflicts damage on the attacker upon contact with iron barbs.
iron-barbs.textEs: Inflige daño al rival si este le golpea con un movimiento de contacto.
iron-barbs.detail: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Rough Skin.

comatose.textEn: The Pokémon is always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack while in its sleeping state.
comatose.textEs: No despierta jamás de su profundo letargo e incluso ataca dormido.
comatose.detail: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep. It cannot be given another status ailment; it's unaffected by Yawn; it can use Sleep Talk; and so on.

bulletproof.textEn: Protects the Pokémon from ball and bomb moves.
bulletproof.textEs: No le afectan las bombas ni algunos proyectiles.
bulletproof.detail: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

tinted-lens.textEn: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.
tinted-lens.textEs: Potencia los movimientos que no son muy eficaces, que infligen ahora un daño normal.
tinted-lens.detail: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.

battery.textEn: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.
battery.textEs: Potencia los ataques especiales de los aliados.
battery.detail: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.

water-bubble.textEn: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.
water-bubble.textEs: Reduce el daño que le provocan los movimientos de tipo Fuego y es inmune a las quemaduras.
water-bubble.detail: When this Pokémon is hit by a Fire move, the damage is halved. When this Pokémon uses a Water move, the power is doubled. This Pokémon cannot be burned, and if it becomes burned, the burn is immediately cured.

symbiosis.textEn: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.
symbiosis.textEs: Pasa su objeto a un aliado que ya haya utilizado el suyo.
symbiosis.detail: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.

snow-warning.textEn: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.
snow-warning.textEs: Invoca una tormenta de granizo al entrar en combate.
snow-warning.detail: The weather changes to hail when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Sand Stream are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

schooling.textEn: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.
schooling.textEs: Forma bancos con sus congéneres cuando tiene muchos PS, lo cual le otorga más fuerza. Cuando le quedan pocos PS, el banco se dispersa.
schooling.detail: If this Pokémon is a Wishiwashi and level 20 or above, then when it enters battle and at the start of each turn, it becomes Schooling Form if its HP is 25% or higher and Solo Form otherwise. This ability cannot be replaced, copied, or nullified.

receiver.textEn: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
receiver.textEs: Adquiere la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
receiver.detail: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

innards-out.textEn: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.
innards-out.textEs: Al caer debilitado, inflige al rival un daño equivalente a los PS que le quedaran.
innards-out.detail: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.

klutz.textEn: The Pokémon can't use any held items.
klutz.detail: In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative. This Pokémon also cannot use Fling. The Speed cut from the Iron Ball and the effort items (the Macho Brace, Power Weight, Power Bracer, Power Belt, Power Lens, Power Band, and Power Anklet) is unaffected. Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the Exp. Share, the Amulet Coin, or the Soothe Bell, work as usual. All held items work as usual out of battle. Other moves that use the held item, such as Natural Gift and Switcheroo, work as usual.

plus.textEn: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
plus.textEs: Potencia su Ataque Especial si un Pokémon aliado tiene la habilidad Más o Menos.
plus.detail: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

forecast.textEn: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.
forecast.textEs: Cambia a tipo Agua, Fuego o Hielo en función del tiempo atmosférico.
forecast.detail: During rain, strong sunlight, or hail, this Pokémon's type changes to Water, Fire, or Ice, respectively, and its form changes to match. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Castform. If the weather ends or becomes anything that does not trigger this ability, or a Pokémon with Air Lock or Cloud Nine enters battle, this Pokémon's type and form revert to their default. If this ability is lost or disabled, this Pokémon cannot change its current type and form until it regains its ability.

minus.textEn: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
minus.textEs: Potencia su Ataque Especial si un Pokémon aliado tiene la habilidad Más o Menos.
minus.detail: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

filter.textEn: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.
filter.textEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
filter.detail: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Solid Rock.

long-reach.textEn: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
long-reach.textEs: Puede usar cualquier movimiento sin entrar en contacto con el rival.
long-reach.detail: A move used by this Pokémon will not make contact.

liquid-voice.textEs: Hace que todos sus movimientos que usan sonido pasen a ser de tipo Agua.
liquid-voice.detail: When this Pokémon uses a move that is sound-based, that move's type is Water.

berserk.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.
berserk.textEs: Aumenta su Ataque Especial si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad debido a algún ataque.
berserk.detail: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move that causes its HP to drop below 50%, its Special Attack rises by one stage.

rivalry.textEn: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.
rivalry.textEs: Si el objetivo es del mismo sexo, su competitividad le lleva a infligir más daño. Si es del sexo contrario, en cambio, el daño será menor.
rivalry.detail: This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender. If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.

slush-rush.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.
slush-rush.textEs: Aumenta su Velocidad si está granizando.
slush-rush.detail: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.

pure-power.textEn: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.
pure-power.textEs: Duplica la potencia de sus ataques físicos gracias al yoga.
pure-power.detail: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Huge Power.

cud-chew.textEn: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
cud-chew.textEs: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
cud-chew.detail: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

galvanize.textEn: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
galvanize.textEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Eléctrico y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
galvanize.detail: When this Pokémon uses a Normal moves, that move is Electric its power is 1.2×.

toxic-debris.textEn: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
toxic-debris.textEs: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
toxic-debris.detail: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

wind-rider.textEn: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
wind-rider.textEs: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
wind-rider.detail: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

cheek-pouch.textEn: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.
cheek-pouch.textEs: Recupera PS al comer cualquier baya.
cheek-pouch.detail: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.

purifying-salt.textEn: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
purifying-salt.textEs: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
purifying-salt.detail: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

wandering-spirit.textEn: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
wandering-spirit.textEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, intercambia su habilidad con la del agresor.
wandering-spirit.detail: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

super-luck.textEn: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.
super-luck.textEs: Su buena suerte aumenta la probabilidad de asestar golpes críticos.
super-luck.detail: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.

imposter.textEn: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.
imposter.textEs: Se transforma en el Pokémon que tiene enfrente.
imposter.detail: This Pokémon transforms into a random opponent upon entering battle. This effect is identical to the move Transform.

merciless.textEn: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
merciless.textEs: Hace que sus movimientos asesten siempre un golpe crítico si el rival está envenenado.
merciless.detail: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.

screen-cleaner.textEn: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
screen-cleaner.textEs: Anula los efectos de Pantalla de Luz, Reflejo y Velo Aurora tanto de rivales como de aliados al entrar en combate.
screen-cleaner.detail: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

solid-rock.textEn: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.
solid-rock.textEs: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
